facts.fact: NIRA's Director General says the Hubiye platform is operational for verification by relying parties through an API.
NIRA says the eAqoonsi app has launched for digital ID access, on Google Play and the App Store.

SOM.note: The deck names no link between civil register and ID.

facts.fact: NIRA's deck lists as safeguards that the National Data Protection Act is enacted and a Data Protection Authority is established.
NIRA's deck states the National Data Protection Act is enacted.
NIRA's deck states a Data Protection Authority is established.
NIRA says the National ID Law (Law No. 009 of March 2023) is enacted and NIRA was mandated in March 2023 to implement it.

SOM.note: No enrolment count is given; 15 million by 2029 is a target.
The deck says nothing on a number at birth.
The deck says who builds and runs the platform only in general terms of partnering with experienced players.
The deck lists bodies connected for verification, not registers keyed on the number.

facts.fact: NIRA says the national ID programme launched in September 2023 and issues an 11-digit unique national ID number with digital and physical cards.
NIRA lists fingerprints and facial recognition as features of the national ID, with biometric verification capability tested.
NIRA reports banks, notaries, microfinance and some ministries are connected to the Hubiye platform to verify people against the national ID.
NIRA's deck counts relying parties connected: 6 private and 2 public, with others in progress.

SOM.note: The deck says international standards were adopted for the ID platform but names no standard or standards body.

facts.fact: NIRA's Director General says Somalia's technical pool is limited and it leverages external expertise and partners such as NADRA while keeping in-house resources on development, oversight, policy and coordination.
